about: Word Bank marks that an earlier review (word-bank-review.json) had scored, on a word the second listen (TR-22) no longer hears on that line. Each is its own ledger state (rehear-word-conflict): scored neither right nor wrong, left out of Words %, until someone looks. Generated by scripts/build_lessons_page_data.py (scripts/lesson_ledger.py); never edit by hand.
